name: Asu Kana! ~Asu wa Kanarazu Sasotte ne!~
original_name: あす・かな!～明日は必ず誘ってね!～
source:
Falling in love with a half-german tsundere girl who's just returned home to Japan...

Asukana! is an erotic story of nonstop wicked curiosities and youth.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE037544.html]DLsite English[/url]]

愛上一個剛回到日本的有一半德國血統的傲嬌女孩……

《明日香奈！》是一部充滿不間斷邪惡好奇心與青春氣息的色情故事。
